svg.title: The rigid-axis PID on the flexible axis, without and with a 3 hertz notch
svg.desc: Without a notch the load swings three times per second with growing maxima, 0.65, 1.33, 1.72 and 1.91 radians, until the safety limit removes the torque at 1.34 seconds. With a 3 hertz notch of quality factor 1 the same PID settles within 0.02 radians of the target from 3.08 seconds.
svg.text: The rigid-axis PID on the flexible axis, without and with a 3 Hz notch
Control Studio validation of this project on the actual ST · target 0 → 1 rad at 0 s · numbers answer the predictions
No notch: swings at 3 Hz, 0.65 → 1.33 → 1.72 → 1.91 rad
